description: Professional privacy protection. One-click cleanup of browsing data.
name: Web Privacy - 1-Click Cleanup

permissions_justification.alarms: Used for scheduled privacy cleanup tasks and reminders
permissions_justification.browsingData: Core functionality - allows users to clear browsing history, cache, cookies, and download history
permissions_justification.data_usage: All data processing happens locally. No user data is transmitted to external servers. Extension only accesses browsing data for cleanup purposes as explicitly requested by the user.
permissions_justification.host_permissions: Needed to inject content scripts for sensitive site detection across all websites
permissions_justification.notifications: Used to notify users about completed cleanup operations and privacy alerts
permissions_justification.remote_code: No remote code execution - all functionality runs locally in the browser
permissions_justification.storage: Stores user preferences, cleanup settings, and last cleanup timestamp locally
